items.zh: 我来中国已经一年了。
items.py: Wǒ lái Zhōngguó yǐjīng yī nián le.
items.en: I've been in China for a year already.

items.zh: 这一年我学到了很多东西。
items.py: Zhè yī nián wǒ xué dào le hěn duō dōngxi.
items.en: I've learned a lot this year.

items.zh: 我不但会说汉语，而且会写汉字了。
items.py: Wǒ búdàn huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě huì xiě Hànzì le.
items.en: I can not only speak Chinese, but also write characters.

items.zh: 虽然还有很多不会的，但是我会继续努力。
items.py: Suīrán hái yǒu hěn duō bú huì de, dànshì wǒ huì jìxù nǔlì.
items.en: Although there's still much I don't know, I'll keep working hard.

items.zh: 谢谢老师和同学们的帮助。
items.py: Xièxie lǎoshī hé tóngxuémen de bāngzhù.
items.en: Thank you for the help from teachers and classmates.

items.zh: 中国给我留下了很深的印象。
items.py: Zhōngguó gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
items.en: China has left a deep impression on me.

items.zh: 大卫：老师们，同学们，大家好！
items.py: Dàwèi: Lǎoshīmen, tóngxuémen, dàjiā hǎo!
items.en: David: Teachers, classmates, hello everyone!

items.zh: 大卫：我来中国已经一年了。时间过得真快！
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ lái Zhōngguó yǐjīng yī nián le. Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài!
items.en: David: I've been in China for a year. Time flies!

items.zh: 大卫：这一年我学到了很多东西。
items.py: Dàwèi: Zhè yī nián wǒ xué dào le hěn duō dōngxi.
items.en: David: I've learned so much this year.

items.zh: 大卫：我不但学会了说汉语，而且了解了中国文化。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ búdàn xuéhuì le shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě liǎojiě le Zhōngguó wénhuà.
items.en: David: I've not only learned to speak Chinese but also understood Chinese culture.

items.zh: 大卫：中国给我留下了很深的印象。
items.py: Dàwèi: Zhōngguó gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
items.en: David: China has left a deep impression on me.

items.zh: 大卫：我真舍不得离开这儿。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ zhēn shě bu de líkāi zhèr.
items.en: David: I'm really reluctant to leave.

items.zh: 大卫：谢谢老师和同学们的帮助。
items.py: Dàwèi: Xièxie lǎoshī hé tóngxuémen de bāngzhù.
items.en: David: Thank you all for your help.

items.zh: 大卫：希望大家以后常联系。
items.py: Dàwèi: Xīwàng dàjiā yǐhòu cháng liánxì.
items.en: David: I hope we'll all stay in touch.

items.zh: 大卫：祝大家身体健康，万事如意！
items.py: Dàwèi: Zhù dàjiā shēntǐ jiànkāng, wànshì rúyì!
items.en: David: Wishing everyone good health and all the best!

items.en: not only... but also...

items.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而且会写汉字。
items.py: Tā búdàn huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě huì xiě Hànzì.
items.en: He can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.

items.zh: 这个菜不但好看，而且好吃。
items.py: Zhège cài búdàn hǎokàn, érqiě hǎo chī.
items.en: This dish not only looks good but also tastes good.

items.zh: 他不但聪明，而且很努力。
items.py: Tā búdàn cōngming, érqiě hěn nǔlì.
items.en: He's not only smart but also hardworking.

items.zh: 北京不但是中国的首都，而且是文化中心。
items.py: Běijīng búdàn shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū, érqiě shì wénhuà zhōngxīn.
items.en: Beijing is not only China's capital but also a cultural center.

items.zh: 我来中国已经一年了。→ 他来北京已经半年了。
items.py: Wǒ lái Zhōngguó yǐjīng yī nián le. → Tā lái Běijīng yǐjīng bàn nián le.
items.en: I've been in China for a year. → He's been in Beijing for half a year.

items.zh: 祝你一路平安！
items.py: Zhù nǐ yīlù píng'ān!
items.en: Have a safe journey!

items.zh: 祝你工作顺利！
items.py: Zhù nǐ gōngzuò shùnlì!
items.en: Wish you success at work!

items.zh: 祝大家新年快乐！
items.py: Zhù dàjiā xīnnián kuàilè!
items.en: Happy New Year to everyone!

items.zh: 中国给我留下了很深的印象。
items.py: Zhōngguó gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
items.en: China left a deep impression on me.

items.zh: 这次旅行给我留下了难忘的经历。
items.py: Zhè cì lǚxíng gěi wǒ liú xià le nánwàng de jīnglì.
items.en: This trip gave me unforgettable experiences.

items.zh: 感谢大家这一年来的帮助。
items.py: Gǎnxiè dàjiā zhè yī nián lái de bāngzhù.
items.en: Thank you all for your help this year.

items.zh: 我永远不会忘记在中国的时光。
items.py: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn bú huì wàngjì zài Zhōngguó de shíguāng.
items.en: I'll never forget my time in China.

items.zh: 我们的友谊地久天长。
items.py: Wǒmen de yǒuyì dìjiǔ tiāncháng.
items.en: May our friendship last forever.

items.zh: 后会有期！
items.py: Hòu huì yǒu qī!
items.en: Until we meet again!

items.zh: 保重！
items.py: Bǎozhòng!
items.en: Take care!
